# Adhiroha

> Adhiroha is a yoga school in Upper Tapovan, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. It offers 200-hour, 300-hour and 500-hour yoga teacher training courses.

Address: Adhiroha Trek Road, Upper Tapovan, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India 249137
Phone: +91 99990 48900
Email: info@adhiroha.com
Website: https://www.adhiroha.com/

## Courses
- [200-hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh](https://www.adhiroha.com/200-hour-yoga-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [300-hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh](https://www.adhiroha.com/300-hour-yoga-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [500-hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh](https://www.adhiroha.com/500-hour-yoga-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [Ashtanga teacher training](https://www.adhiroha.com/ashtanga-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [Hatha teacher training](https://www.adhiroha.com/hatha-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [Pranayama teacher training](https://www.adhiroha.com/pranayama-teacher-training-course-rishikesh/)
- [Sound healing teacher training](https://www.adhiroha.com/sound-healing-ttc-rishikesh/)
